The newborn Shakyamuni Buddha is the exact actor who walks seven steps in each direction, points to heaven and earth, and makes the lion's roar; this is narration of his act, not an anonymous master's saying.

t_c8ef8a6a8ef7:0029c18:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Shakyamuni Buddha biography. Shakyamuni Buddha is the exact speaker who asks Mahakasyapa which Manjusri he intends to expel; Mahakasyapa gives no answer.

t_ba6668ef3e6e:0031a07:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Shakyamuni Buddha biography. In the flower-sermon account Shakyamuni Buddha is the exact speaker who announces the treasury of the true Dharma eye and entrusts it to Mahakasyapa after Mahakasyapa smiles.

t_77774b8724f1:0034b10:1:4.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), biography of the Tenth Patriarch Parshva (脇尊者). Parshva is the exact grammatical actor: after entrusting the teaching to Punyayashas, he manifests transformations and enters nirvana.

t_ac2e2908084d:0051a21:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Yunju Zhi section. Yunju Zhi is the exact speaker answering what seeing the nature and becoming buddha means; he says nature is buddha and buddha is nature.

t_707c9af5cb8e:0053b18:1:5.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Pozhao Duo section. The exact speaker is an unnamed monk from Niutou who infers, 'If so, then one returns to the source by following the correct'; Pozhao Duo challenges the claimed direction. All six rungs leave the monk personally unnamed.

t_90e46d995978:0055c06:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Zhicheng biography. Zhicheng is the exact grammatical actor: after hearing Shenxiu's instruction he bows farewell, travels to Shaoyang, and joins the assembly to visit and inquire without disclosing where he came from.

t_becc0a1ea8cb:0070b20:1:2.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Mazu Daoyi section. Mazu Daoyi is the exact grammatical actor who returns to the abbot's quarters after his exchange with Layman Pang; Pang bows and follows behind him.

t_d055e572dc64:0070c11:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Mazu Daoyi section, complete Deng Yinfeng–Shitou encounter. Deng Yinfeng is the exact grammatical actor who goes back and asks the same question as before; Shitou Xiqian responds by hissing twice.

t_f3488daf27fd:0076a18:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Guizong Zhichang section. Huangbo Xiyun is the exact quoted speaker: after hearing a monk's report of Guizong's blows, Huangbo says that among Mazu's eighty-four teachers only Guizong is somewhat close.

t_df9aad1ce22d:0076a21:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Guizong Zhichang section. Jiangzhou governor Li Bo is the exact questioner: he accepts Mount Sumeru entering a mustard seed but asks whether a mustard seed containing Sumeru is false talk; Guizong answers him.

t_18ec645f99f7:0087b15:2:2.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Longshan encounter. Dongshan Liangjie is the exact questioner who asks what host within guest is; Longshan answers, 'long years not leaving the house.'

t_2f533e7ff5f8:0090a21:1:3.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Pingtian Puan section. Pingtian Puan is the exact verse author; his verse to the assembly says to drink and eat following conditions and asks what more is to be done.

t_f1eb87aa18ef:0104c07:1:4.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Lingyun Zhiqin section. Lingyun Zhiqin is the exact respondent: when Changsheng Jiaoran asks whence living beings come before chaos divides, Lingyun answers, 'like an exposed pillar bearing a child.'

t_e84753568cda:0104c12:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Lingyun Zhiqin section. Changsheng Jiaoran remains the named exact questioner through the complete exchange and asks what the upward matter is; Lingyun answers, 'break the mirror and come; I will meet you.'

t_e3a829e28b09:0105a07:1:3.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Raoshan Heshang section. The headword occurs in an unnamed monk's exact question, 'What is the sixteen-foot golden body?'; Raoshan answers with the judge and minister line. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

t_d055e572dc64:0112b02:1:4.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Datian Baotong section. Datian Baotong is the exact speaker who answers that wood serves as boat and raft and then says the blind remain blind as before and the mute remain mute as before.

t_f2181872b682:0116a01:1:5.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Baiyan Mingzhe section. Baiyan Mingzhe is the exact speaker who asks the ācārya to lay down a different turning word and offers to open the gruel stores for the summer if it accords with his intent.

t_a989d784dc81:0124b18:1:6.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Jiufeng Daoqian section. Jiufeng Daoqian is the exact speaker of the sustained hall instruction; he challenges the assembly to construe the matter without relying on the three-inch tongue, listen without ears, and distinguish without eyes.

t_acccac1051a4:0125c12:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Yungai Zhiyuan section. The headword is spoken by an unnamed monk asking, 'What is a patch-robed monk?'; Yungai Zhiyuan answers, 'investigating, seeking, and visiting the Way.' All six rungs leave the questioner unnamed.

t_8482770fe735:0128b23:1:2.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Luopu Yuanan section. Luopu Yuanan is the exact speaker answering whether patriarchal intent and scriptural intent are the same or different: no other beast inhabits the lion's den, and fox tracks cease where the elephant king walks.

t_44d14cd3a935:0130a04:1:2.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Huangshan Yuelun biography. Jiashan Shanhui is the exact appraising speaker who calls Huangshan a true lion cub well able to roar after their Luling-rice exchange.

t_6457935dff62:0133c04:1:3.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Heshan Wuyin section. An unnamed monk is the exact speaker who sets aside 'mind itself is buddha' and asks what 'not mind, not buddha' is; Heshan answers that Heshan knows how to beat the drum. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

t_6214dc704b24:0158c08:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Anguo Hongtao section. Anguo Hongtao is the exact respondent who answers a monk's question about the meaning of coming from the West with, 'It is so, but do not understand it wrongly.'

t_a0f2bb1de215:0175c17:1:4.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Baoguo Zhao section. Baoguo Zhao is the exact hall speaker; after striking the rope-seat twice and asking whether the assembly sees and hears, he warns them not to conjecture inside consciousness.

t_df9aad1ce22d:0181b01:1:2.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Longji Shaoxiu section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed monk who asks, 'What is the mustard seed?'; Longji answers that it blocks the monk's eye. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

t_cd9e5485fbe1:0183c07:1:2.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Longxing Yu section. Longxing Yu is the exact respondent: asked what the student's own self is, he answers, 'Zhang the Third and Li the Fourth.'

t_90e46d995978:0194a22:1:2.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Shuangfeng Gu biography. Shuangfeng Gu is the exact grammatical actor: after serving his former Shuangfeng teacher for years, he goes to Shishuang, merely follows the assembly, and does not perform a formal visit and inquiry.

t_acccac1051a4:0196a16:1:2.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Bajiao Jiche section. An unnamed monk is the exact speaker who asks what the patch-robed monk's own affair is; Bajiao answers, 'when you want to walk, walk; when you want to sit, sit.' All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

t_358f56dbf990:0205b08:1:4.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Baoci Xingyan section. Baoci Xingyan is the exact hall speaker who says that travelling practitioners visit good teachers, reach a monastery, and set down bottle and bowls.

t_8a016f49e5b8:0207a22:1:4.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Baoen Kuangyi section. Baoen Kuangyi is the exact hall speaker: looking over the assembly, he tells them not to ponder further because pondering cannot reach it.

t_fab146271b10:0207b22:1:5.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Baoci Wensui section. Baoci explicitly introduces his late teacher Qingliang; Fayan Wenyi is therefore the exact quoted speaker of 'the buddha is a person with nothing going on.' Baoci is the later raiser who adds that such a person cannot now be found.

t_bf1399632fd6:0225b14:1:2.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Kefu Daozhe biography. Kefu Daozhe is the exact questioner who asks Linji Yixuan what taking away the object but not the person is; Linji answers with the king's command and frontier general.

t_ecac19a083df:0225b18:1:3.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Kefu Daozhe section. Kefu Daozhe is the exact author of the verse headed 'taking away the person but not the object,' beginning that conditions themselves bear discrepancy.

t_ba841f6e11c8:0227a10:1:1.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Ding Shangzuo biography. Ding explicitly raises Linji Yixuan's earlier hall case; Linji is the exact quoted speaker who pushes away the hesitant monk and calls the person of no rank a dry shit-stick. Ding is the transmitter, not the speaker of the stored line.

t_ecac19a083df:0237c01:1:5.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Sanjiao Zhisong section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed monk who asks what taking away the person but not the object is; Sanjiao answers that the home country has a road no one reaches. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

t_ddab56ede4ef:0238a09:1:3.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Shoushan Huaizhi section. Shoushan Huaizhi is the exact respondent who answers the question 'What is buddha?' with 'the bucket-bottom falls out.'

t_7cddddb76d37:0250a14:1:5.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Lingyin Dezhang section. t_ce2a5ef71afe:0318a20:1:6.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Ziyan Shangzuo section. An unnamed monk is the exact speaker who asks the purport of Dongshan's 'three pounds of flax'; Ziyan answers with an eighty-year-old woman not applying makeup. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

t_f7bdd2def0ec:0373a24:1:3.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Jiuding Huiquan section. Jiuding Huiquan is the exact hall speaker who raises Yunmen Wenyan's three phrases and names the phrase that cuts off the many streams before offering his own three phrases.
